chunks: When it is said to them: 'Follow what God has revealed,' they reply: 'No, we shall follow only what our fathers had practiced,' -- even though their fathers had no wisdom or guidance!
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about blind following of ancestors?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to critique 'Taqlid' (blind imitation) when it supersedes rational deduction ('Aql') and direct engagement with divine text. It underscores the principle that ancestral tradition holds no authority if it contradicts the clear guidance of the Quran, emphasizing the necessity of intellectual discernment in religious practice.
